title: The categories are tentative formulations, judged by progress

statements.text: The categories of the scheme are not statements of the obvious but tentative formulations of the most general truths. A generalization is tested by whether it applies beyond the field it came from, and the proper test of a philosophy is progress, not finality.

sources.quote: Metaphysical categories are not dogmatic statements of the obvious; they are tentative formulations of the ultimate generalities.
